base_probability_model: 50/50 ensemble of multinomial logistic regression and ExtraTrees; features use only pre-race context and each entrant's prior races

candidate_calibrators.isotonic: One-vs-rest isotonic regression followed by renormalization
candidate_calibrators.vector: Multinomial logistic recalibration on log probabilities

selection_rule: Use 2025 only. Primary metric log loss, with Brier/ECE and parsimony as secondary criteria. 2026 must not be used to choose the method.

decision.reason: No calibrator produced a reproducible 2025 improvement over the raw ensemble. Temperature was effectively identity (T≈0.986), isotonic overfit, and vector calibration did not materially improve log loss while worsening top-label ECE. Parsimony therefore favors the raw ensemble.

final_2026_holdout.note: The holdout supports useful probability ranking, but calibration is not perfect. Display probabilities with an uncertainty note and avoid interpreting 70% as an exact long-run frequency without ongoing recalibration monitoring.

deployment_guidance: Use raw ensemble probabilities in v1; do not add isotonic/vector calibration yet.
Show all four RPCI probabilities, not only the argmax band.
Track realized RPCI and append a calibration audit by season/month.
Recalibrate only if rolling log loss/Brier/ECE materially deteriorate on new unseen data.
Keep 2026 frozen as the final validation reference for v1.
